summary: The order-service 500s are caused by dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0, deployed 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z), which added MarginCheckValidator to the validation chain and removed the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(); on the F&O (derivatives) order path the new validator dereferences a null marginProfile and throws NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88, producing HTTP 500. Confidence is medium (top hypothesis ranked at 0.60, clearly ahead of the alternatives): onset is pinned to 12:12Z by metrics and the first ERROR log at 12:12:31Z, all 426 errors share the identical local NPE signature on orderType=FNO, and resource metrics (CPU, latency, memory, DB pool) are flat, ruling out capacity exhaustion. The competing "dependency returns null" origin is contradicted by topology (no margin/account lookup service exists in order-service's dependency closure) and by flat redis-cache/ledger-db metrics across the onset. Residual uncertainty is the lack of source-diff and schema access, so the exact null-production mechanism (removal of a populating step vs read-before-populate) is unverified, but the fix target — roll back dep-5101 — is not in dispute.

ranked_hypotheses.title: dep-5101 (v2.14.0 MarginCheckValidator) introduced a null-dereference on the F&O order path
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0, 12:10Z) replaced the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with a new MarginCheckValidator in the validation chain. On the F&O order path the new validator dereferences a marginProfile that is null (because the removed legacy step was the thing that populated it, or because the new code reads it before population), throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500 for every derivatives order. All harm originates in the order-service release; the failure is the new code path, not a downstream dependency.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 deploys v2.14.0 to order-service at 12:10Z, adding MarginCheckValidator and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() — the only change event touching order-service or any dependency in the window

The new validator's margin lookup yields marginProfile=null on F&O orders — either because the legacy populate call was removed together with validateMargin(), or because the new code reads marginProfile before population
Null marginProfile is dereferenced at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 -> NullPointerException on every FNO order
The NPE propagates as an HTTP 500 to POST /v1/orders, matching ~1/5 of traffic (the F&O share)
Failure is functional and immediate (fast rejection), so no latency/CPU/pool symptom appears

assumptions: That marginProfile was previously populated by the removed OrderRules.validateMargin() or an equivalent step, so removing/reordering it is what produces null
That no earlier (<10:00Z) deploy on a dependency is responsible; only 10:00-13:59Z deploys were inventoried
That the ~18-19% error share equals the F&O traffic share, i.e. F&O failures are near-total
That v2.14.0's F&O path became active at 12:12Z rather than the change being partially staged

ranked_hypotheses.title: A marginProfile data path (account/margin data, plausibly via the shared redis-cache) returns null for F&O accounts and the new validator fails to tolerate it
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The marginProfile consumed by MarginCheckValidator is fetched from a dependency rather than built locally; that source began returning null/empty for F&O accounts around 12:12Z, so the validator's null handling fails and orders 500. Origin is the data-providing dependency/account-data path, not order-service code — which changes the fix target from rollback to a dependency/data fix.

causal_chain.claim: MarginCheckValidator reads marginProfile from an account/margin data source rather than computing it locally
That source stopped returning a profile for FNO accounts at ~12:12Z (key-level cache miss/null, stale ledger read, or account data change) without moving aggregate cache health
Validator has no null guard/tolerant default, so the null becomes a NullPointerException at line 88
500s surface only on the F&O order path, matching the observed ~18-19% error regime
No modelled dependency shows degradation: portfolio-service flat, order-service latency/pool/CPU flat, redis-cache hit_ratio/evictions/cpu flat, ledger-db slow-queries/lag flat

assumptions: marginProfile comes from a remote lookup rather than a local structure (no schema/DDL/source access)
The lookup would fail only for F&O orders and only after 12:12Z while aggregate redis hit_ratio stays ~96% (narrow key-level null not visible in aggregate)
Any dependency-side fault is invisible only because telemetry was not sampled per-dependency and redis-cache has no error_rate metric (F19); kafka metric query timed out

ranked_hypotheses.statement: A shared platform-owned component beneath order-service degraded at ~12:12Z (e.g. ledger-db IOPS/connections, redis-cache, or kafka), and order-service surfaces those failures as 500s on derivatives orders, mirroring precedent HIST-110.

ranked_hypotheses.statement: A surge in order traffic exhausted order-service CPU, latency or DB connection pool, producing 500s rather than a functional code fault.

dep-5101 at 12:10:00Z precedes the reported onset (12:22:00Z) and the observed onset (12:12Z), and no rollback is recorded as of latest data (13:59Z); no other deployment or config change touched order-service or its dependencies in the window.

All 426 order-service ERROR logs share one signature: NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) with 'marginProfile is null' for orderType=FNO; the two matched patterns both occur only on FNO (derivatives) orders.

ledger-db, the only db order-service writes to and a shared platform-owned postgres, has no downstream edges of its own (it is a leaf), so it cannot be fetching a marginProfile; a marginProfile could only be constructed locally or stored in ledger-db/redis-cache.

The shared datastores under order-service are flat across the onset: redis-cache hit_ratio 95.94% at 12:10Z and 95.16% at 12:15Z with evictions and cpu_pct flat (F21, F22); ledger-db slow_queries_per_min (12:10Z 0.99, 12:15Z 1.08) and replication_lag_ms (12:10Z 39.88, 12:15Z 39.74) flat (F23).

No historical incident in the precedent searches concerns a marginProfile null / MarginCheckValidator / F&O validation-population defect; the best matches (exchange partner outage -> 504s, JWT clock-skew 401s, ledger-db IOPS throttling -> slow orders, datasource pool misconfig) are not H1- or H2-shaped.

redis-cache and ledger-db expose no error_rate metric, and kafka's metric list was never retrieved, so those components' health can only be assessed via proxy metrics (hit_ratio, evictions, cpu, connections, disk, replication lag, slow queries).

recommended_actions.rationale: dep-5101 is the only deployment and only margin-related change in the window, preceding the 12:12Z onset by 12 minutes; it is still live with no rollback. All 426 errors surface inside the code it added (MarginCheckValidator.java:88).
